$doc: Naming registry backing R-316 and the decidable half of R-317. This file is the data form of the verb lexicon written into rulebook/reference.md R-316: 'is this a good name' is undecidable, 'is this verb in the lexicon' is a set membership test. Synonyms are disambiguated by layer rather than left to taste: the R-304/R-305 directory a file sits in is what makes 'remote' vs 'in memory' decidable from the path instead of from intent. Edit this file and that Spec bullet together. A repo opts in with a naming key in its .enforce.json and may replace or extend any list; see enforce/README.md.

verbMeanings.build: Produce a runnable, distributable, or assembled artifact from source inputs.
verbMeanings.calculate: Compute a numeric quantity using explicit arithmetic or an algorithm.
verbMeanings.compare: Determine equality or ordering between existing values without changing them.
verbMeanings.compose: Combine existing functions or parts into a larger operation or value.
verbMeanings.convert: Change a value between types, units, or representations while preserving its meaning.
verbMeanings.create: Introduce a new domain entity or resource that does not yet exist, including a new DOM element.
verbMeanings.decode: Recover a value from a specified encoding.
verbMeanings.delete: Remove an existing domain entity or resource; use exclude for a filtered copy of a collection.
verbMeanings.derive: Compute a new domain fact from existing facts without changing those inputs.
verbMeanings.drop: Remove a database or repository structure or record; restricted to the declared database and repository trees.
verbMeanings.encode: Represent a value using a specified encoding.
verbMeanings.ensure: Establish a named condition, making only the changes needed when it is not already satisfied.
verbMeanings.exclude: Return a collection without selected members, leaving the source collection unchanged.
verbMeanings.extract: Take a named component from a larger existing value without changing it.
verbMeanings.fetch: Retrieve from a remote source; use the declared api or clients layer rather than performing remote I/O in a getter.
verbMeanings.filter: Select collection members by a predicate without changing the source collection.
verbMeanings.find: Search existing values for a matching item without changing them.
verbMeanings.format: Change an input string to a requested display format; return the changed string when strings are immutable.
verbMeanings.generate: Produce algorithmic, synthetic, or templated content; use create to introduce an entity or resource.
verbMeanings.get: Retrieve a local value or read-only derived representation; do not create domain entities or mutate caller-owned state.
verbMeanings.group: Organize existing items into groups by a stated key or criterion.
verbMeanings.handle: Respond to a specific incoming event or request at an application boundary.
verbMeanings.insert: Add a new database or repository record; restricted to the declared database and repository trees.
verbMeanings.list: Return a collection of existing entities; cardinality is part of the name, and transport stays in the appropriate layer.
verbMeanings.load: Retrieve configuration, stored data, or prompt content in the declared config, database, prompts, or repositories tree.
verbMeanings.log: Write a diagnostic event through the configured logger.
verbMeanings.map: Transform each collection member into a corresponding output member.
verbMeanings.merge: Combine multiple existing values according to an explicit conflict-resolution policy.
verbMeanings.normalize: Convert equivalent input forms into one canonical representation.
verbMeanings.parse: Interpret input syntax or meaning into usable values; use format for display-only string changes.
verbMeanings.prepare: Make named inputs or resources ready for a specific subsequent operation.
verbMeanings.publish: Make content or an artifact available to its intended external audience.
verbMeanings.read: Consume bytes, text, or a stream through a local I/O primitive; do not use as a synonym for domain retrieval.
verbMeanings.register: Associate an existing handler, resource, or implementation with a registry.
verbMeanings.render: Produce or update a visual presentation from state.
verbMeanings.report: Send a structured error, status, or finding to its designated reporting destination.
verbMeanings.resolve: Determine a concrete target or value from a reference, competing candidates, or deferred information.
verbMeanings.route: Direct an incoming request or event to its designated destination.
verbMeanings.save: Persist an entity when creation versus updating is intentionally unspecified.
verbMeanings.schedule: Arrange for a named operation to run at a specified later time or condition.
verbMeanings.select: Choose a member or subset from existing candidates using explicit criteria.
verbMeanings.send: Transmit a message or payload to a recipient or destination.
verbMeanings.serialize: Convert structured values to a storage or transmission representation.
verbMeanings.sort: Order a collection by stated comparison rules; document whether the source is changed.
verbMeanings.split: Divide an existing value or collection into parts.
verbMeanings.start: Begin the active lifecycle of a named process, service, or ongoing operation.
verbMeanings.stop: End the active lifecycle of a named process, service, or ongoing operation.
verbMeanings.subscribe: Arrange to receive future events or changes from a named source.
verbMeanings.sync: Reconcile named states according to an explicit source-of-truth and conflict policy.
verbMeanings.to: Map a value to a named target representation using the approved toX mapper form.
verbMeanings.track: Record an explicitly named analytics event through the configured analytics boundary.
verbMeanings.transform: Apply a named structural transformation when no more specific approved operation fits.
verbMeanings.update: Change an existing entity or its state, including replacing that state or changing an existing DOM element.
verbMeanings.upsert: Create or update a database or repository record atomically; restricted to the declared trees.
verbMeanings.validate: Reject or report values that violate a stated input or state contract without repairing them.
verbMeanings.verify: Check an external claim or postcondition against independent evidence; use validate for input contracts.
verbMeanings.write: Output bytes or text through a local I/O primitive; use save for domain persistence.
